rules.name: Detachment Points
rules.text: To use this detachment you must spend 1DP.

rules.name: Strike from the Warp
rules.text:
• When a friendly CROWE'S SANCTIFIERS unit ends a charge move, if that unit made an ingress move this turn, you can select one enemy unit engaged with that friendly unit. If you do, that enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll.
• When playing a Combat Patrol battle, the following friendly units must start the battle in strategic reserves and cannot be set up on the battlefield before the battle round stated. When doing so, they must be set up wholly within your deployment zone.
• BROTHERHOOD TERMINATOR SQUAD: Battle round 2.
• VENERABLE DREADNOUGHT: Battle round 3.

rules.name: Gate of Infinity
rules.text:
If your Army Faction is GREY KNIGHTS, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, you can select a number of units (see below) from your army that are on the battlefield (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), provided every model in those units has this ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Sanctified Auspexes
enhancements.text: Upgrade: CROWE'S SANCTIFIERS VENERABLE DREADNOUGHT unit only. This unit's ranged attacks can re-roll one hit roll.

enhancements.name: Purifying Force
enhancements.text: Upgrade: CROWE'S SANCTIFIERS BROTHERHOOD TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. (Once per battle, per army) When this unit is selected to fight, if it made a charge move this turn, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Exigent Assignments
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CROWE'S SANCTIFIERS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effect: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Refusal to Yield
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CROWE'S SANCTIFIERS STRIKE SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That CROWE'S SANCTIFIERS STRIKE SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Psi-reactive Ammunition
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CROWE'S SANCTIFIERS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's storm bolter weapons have [PSYCHIC].

rules.name: Inquisitorial Sanction
rules.text: [Combat Patrol mission card shown under 'YOUR MISSION' on the Battle Setup screen — not a patrol ability card.] ANY BATTLE ROUND — When: End of your turn. For each enemy CHARACTER model destroyed in this or the previous turn: 10VP. SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS — When: End of your turn. You control two or more objectives: 5VP. You control one or more objectives: 5VP. END OF THE BATTLE — All enemy CHARACTER models are destroyed: 10VP. (A collapsed 'Lore' accordion was not expanded.)

rules.name: Expansionary Campaign
rules.text: [Combat Patrol mission card shown under 'OPPONENT'S MISSION' on the Battle Setup screen — belongs to the opposing patrol, identity not shown.] FIRST TO SECOND BATTLE ROUND — When: End of your turn. You control two or more expansion objectives: 15VP. You control one or more expansion objectives: 10VP. THIRD BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS — When: End of your turn. You control one or more expansion objectives: 5VP. You control two or more expansion objectives: 10VP. (A collapsed 'Lore' accordion was not expanded.)

rules.name: Detachment Points
rules.text: To use this detachment you must spend 1DP.

rules.name: Co-ordinated Eradication
rules.text: (Once per battle, per army) When a friendly SUDDEN DAWN CADRE unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, select one enemy unit. Friendly SUDDEN DAWN CADRE units' attacks that target that enemy unit have +1 AP until the end of the battle.

rules.name: Drones
rules.text:
If you have upgraded a model to have a drone, place a Drone token next to your model as a reminder. These do not count as models for any rules purposes.

Shield Drone
Add 1 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic.

rules.name: For the Greater Good
rules.text:
If your Army Faction is T'AU EMPIRE, at the start of your Shooting phase you can select units from your army with this ability to become Observer units.

During your Shooting phase, for each Observer unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is eligible to shoot (excluding FORTIFICATION and Battle-shocked units] select one enemy unit that is visible to be marked as their Spotted unit until the end of the phase. Each enemy unit can only be marked as a Spotted unit once per phase.

Units from your army with the For the Greater Good ability (excluding Observer units) are Guided units while targeting one or more Spotted units.

Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your army in a Guided unit makes an attack that targets a Spotted unit, improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of that attack by 1 and, if the Spotted unit was marked by an Observer unit that has the Markerlight keyword, that attack has the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Proximity Scanners
enhancements.text: Upgrade: SUDDEN DAWN CADRE DEVILFISH unit only. When a friendly unit embarked within this unit disembarks, that friendly unit's pulse blaster and pulse carbine weapons have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Earth Caste Modifications
enhancements.text:
SUDDEN DAWN CADRE COMMANDER IN ENFORCER BATTLESUIT model only.
• When this unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
• While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.
• When this unit makes an ingress move, it can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"). If this unit does, is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Suppressing Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SUDDEN DAWN CADRE INFANTRY unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That SUDDEN DAWN CADRE INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is pinned until the start of your next Command phase:
• While a unit is pinned, that unit has -2" M.

stratagems.name: Rapid Acquisition
stratagems.target: One friendly SUDDEN DAWN CADRE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Swift Embarkation
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged SUDDEN DAWN CADRE INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly SUDDEN DAWN CADRE TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

rules.name: Detachment Points
rules.text: To use this detachment you must spend 1DP.

rules.name: Honoured Knights
rules.text:
When an enemy unit ends a charge move, friendly VENGEFUL BRETHREN units engaged with that enemy unit are in defence stance until the end of the turn:
• While a unit is in defence stance, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

rules.name: Oath of Moment (Army Rule)
rules.text: This ability is described in full in the Army Rules section of Codex: Space Marines.

rules.name: The Deathwing (Army Rule)
rules.text:
The following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units gain the DEATHWING keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter:
■ TERMINATOR units
■ BLADEGUARD ANCIENT, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD and VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS units
■ LAND RAIDER, LAND RAIDER CRUSADER, LAND RAIDER REDEEMER, REPULSOR and REPULSOR EXECUTIONER units
■ DREADNOUGHT units

rules.name: The Ravenwing (Army Rule)
rules.text:
The following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units gain the RAVENWING keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter:
■ MOUNTED units
■ VEHICLE units that can FLY

rules.name: The Unforgiven (Army Rule)
rules.text:
■ If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. For example, Asmodai has both the ADEPTUS ASTARTES and DARK ANGELS Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Dark Angels Chapter.
■ You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

Designer's Note: The rules presented in this section assume that the ADEPTUS ASTARTES units in your army are from the Dark Angels Chapter, but they can also be used to represent any Dark Angels successor Chapter, such as one described in the background section of this book, or even one of your own invention. However, players who wish to faithfully recreate the Dark Angels Chapter on the tabletop should only include DARK ANGELS EPIC HEROES if their collection is intended to represent the First Founding Chapter itself; Ezekiel is the Chief Librarian of the Dark Angels, for example, and not of any of their successors.

enhancements.name: Supreme Combatant
enhancements.text:
VENGEFUL BRETHREN GRAVIS CAPTAIN model only. When this unit is selected to attack, this unit's attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Dutiful Defenders
enhancements.text: Upgrade: VENGEFUL BRETHREN BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit only. (Once per battle round, per army) When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

stratagems.name: For the Lion
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Mission Focus
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly VENGEFUL BRETHREN unit within range of an objective is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Determined to the Last
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly VENGEFUL BRETHREN BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.target: That VENGEFUL BRETHREN BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
• On a 2+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
